tools.name: ask_pandi
tools.description: Prepare or submit a text research question to Pandi. A first call without a request ID prepares a private submission ID. A repeat with that ID, question and locale creates a research job and returns its private receipt.

tools.name: get_ask
tools.description: Read the state, progress or completed text answer and numbered citations for a Pandi research job. The private receipt identifies the job. An optional cursor resumes progress from an earlier read.
